attributes.name: Ubashki Swarm
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, succeed at a Stealth 6 check or each character at your location summons and encounters the Ubashki Swarm.

The Ubashki Swarm is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

If you do not exceed the difficulty of each check to defeat by at least 2, after you act, succeed at a Constitution or Fortitude check 7 check or bury a card.
